name: 04_value_side_min_max
description: CROSS-CORE GUARD for normalize_value — the VALUE-side min-max route. The three existing norm vectors (01-03) all drive only the weight-side effective_weight path; this is the first shared vector on the value-side route the docs call 'decision-equivalent across cores'. Presence of the `valueNorm` block switches the harness to: for each (option, dim) raw value, write Norm.normalize_value(raw, lo, hi) back as the value, then write shared weights, resolve, and assert BOTH the per-cell normalized values (`expectedValues`, bit-exact) and the resolved order. Dim `cost` has range lo=10, hi=20. Cases: a.cost raw 5 is BELOW lo -> clamp to 0.0; b.cost raw 15 is IN range -> (15-10)/(20-10) = 0.5; c.cost raw 30 is ABOVE hi -> clamp to 1.0; d.cost raw +inf is a GATE -> passed through as +inf (NOT normalized away) so resolve DROPS d. Dim `flat` (only on b) has a DEGENERATE range lo=5, hi=5 -> identity, returning the raw 0.0 unchanged (no divide-by-zero, no non-finite leak). Shared weights cost=1.0, flat=1.0. Scores: a=0.0, b=0.5+0.0=0.5, c=1.0; d gated out -> order [a, b, c]. This pins the clamp on both boundaries, the in-range linear map, the degenerate-range identity, and the gate passthrough — every decision edge of normalize_value, identically on both cores. Captured from the live normalize_value + resolve on both cores.
